content: I have just recently done a day trip to Copenhagen travel from and to Luton airport when I saw the long queues for the security check I was amazed at the chaos there. I always worry about my iPad being taken out of the tray while I go through why a jumper cannot cover it up I will never know. Unfortunately I set off the alarm and was put to one side in a queue waiting to be checked when I moved slightly so I had my tray insight one of the officers wax very rude especially when I said I was worried about my iPad being taken she explained there was cctv all around but to be honest if I asked her which was my tray she probably wouldn't have know. This is the second time out of Luton in four six months and it was worse than before. What disappoints me is the cost of this security is placed on my ticket but not at my choice so I feel I should get a better service. All in all it took about twenty minutes to go through am I disgusted yes I am. Also later while waiting to fly I used some of the toilets there maybe they should look at spending some money there too they were far from what I'd call good. No matter how much you want the passenger to pass through on a trip abroad at least make it a better experience not a cattle herding.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Bob Daniel
content: An absolutely ghastly place. As others have noticed they charge you for anything they can think of. The "short term" car park is so far away heaven help you if it is raining. Security is a farce at the best of times at times of minor demand it is appalling. Queued for 30+ minutes to get back into the country through immigration. Never again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: D Taylor
content: Absolute shambles of an airport. Security was the worst I've ever seen just a mass of people in disorganised queues and no staff visible anywhere. I should be seen it coming when I noticed the extensive advertisements for priority security passes - they were pushing you to buy this far more than other airports I've been to and it's clear they are happy to leave the main security hall in chaos do that people will buy a priority pass next time. Although I sincerely hope there isn't a next time for me - I will use any other airport of given the choice.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: T Harvey
content: Have used Luton for many years on a regular basis. £2.50 to pick up and drop off is a rip off. Seating facilities in departures have been sacrificed to allow more retail outlets hence difficulty finding somewhere to sit - particularly if only one plane is delayed. Last arrival on 18th March delayed 20 minutes on plane as nobody had unlocked door to get into terminal! Finally and not wishing to criticise security because its so essential but with two knee replacements which cause the scanner to go off I am body searched to a degree I have never experienced at any other airport. Just find it hugely irritating with rarely anything other than curt dismissal when complete.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Mike Fishpen
content: I refused to pay £2.00 just to collect my partner from the airport it takes exactly 30 seconds to put her luggage in the car and drive off so I stopped outside on the roundabout and received a lovely fine of £80 in the post Â £40 if you pay straight away! Something needs to be done about this how can they justify charging people £2.00 to drop off or collect passengers?

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: D Odonovan
content: The car park situation is outrageous today due to incompetence from airport staff it has taken 2 hours to Drop my mother of at the airport and that was from the Holiday inn next to the airport. This should take 15 mins recommendations - do not close of the main road going out of the airport on a Saturday lunch time! Have people directing traffic on another note Luton feel the need to charge £2.50 to drop of people - what a rip of this is free in other airports I should invoice them my time lost - they would to me!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Graham Gibbs
content: Another scam to drag more money from passengers. Security now refusing to let through your own plastic bags for liquids if they have any lines/writing on them as they obstruct what is in the bag. So what do you have to do? Buy their own ones at £2 for 2 small ones. Passengers being treated as cash cows for this abysmal airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Aubrey
content: Arriving at night I asked the bus driver to take me to the area of the long stay car park where I had left my car and told him the reference. Instead he dropped me off a long way from the correct area. As a result I had to drag four heavy bags around the ranks of cars in torrential rain and almost total darkness in a vain search for my car. Eventually I returned to the bus stop and telephoned for help and was eventually guided to the correct parking place which was a considerable distance away by which time my luggage and I were completely drenched. This is a disgrace.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Gurnam Singh
content: I found the security checks very slow on the Friday morning I travelled with my family to Barcelona from Luton airport. The queues were far too slow and the whole of the waiting area was packed! If we stayed in the queue then we would have missed our flight. We had to ask the guard to let us skip the queues. Other people by us missed their flights. The airport should give a clear guidance on how busy this area can be or was at that time. I realize security is most important but this area seemed out of control to me we made our flight gate with only minutes to spare. Also we did not know that the boarding gate was a good 5 minutes walk away! Nobody on hand to ask for help just all panic.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Unwin
content: Charging to drop people off is unacceptable. Sure charge for those that linger in the drop off area too long but Luton Airport how do you honestly justify charging Â£2 for pulling up outside the terminal and unloading your friends and their luggage in less than 5 minutes? No other airport I have ever used rips travellers off like this.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Julia Gilson
content: Luton airport security is a shambles. Be warned long queues causing passengers to miss their flights. The airport is not taking responsibility for long queues - they must know the volumes of expected passengers and when peak times are and are not providing enough facilities to cope. They should inform the airlines to tell their passengers to allow more time. Easyjet say if you've checked in online arriving 40 mins before a flight is sufficient time when it clearly is not especially for early morning flights. Airport treatment of travellers who have missed flights having turned up on time is appalling - no customer care no help provided. The whole Luton experience is extremely poor.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Kenneth Booth
content: Nice little airport spoilt by just a few things. I would like to see drop off directly outside the terminal not everyone is up to the walk from the car park drop off points. Beware of the duty free shop it's one big rip off. There is no Duty Free within the EEC and you will pay tax on what is already overpriced goods. Whisky priced £39.99 plus hidden tax of £8.00. Same drink at Malta £31 Euro. Beware.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Dominic Dunkley
content: I have been flying to and from Munich every 3-4 months for the past 6 years normally from Stansted or Gatwick. I was pleased to see that easyjet had introduced a new Luton-Munich route last November. For me Luton is only 30 minute train journey. I never did understand why the 'London' Airports had such long departure/arrival queues compared to other European Airports so I booked my next Munich trip from Luton. The outward Journey was on time and the arrival into Munich was smooth and efficient. The return to Luton was a nightmare - after touch down there was a delay in getting off the plane the cabin crew explained that as we had arrived ahead of schedule and ground staff were not really expecting us! Eventually we entered the Terminal Building then a long brisk walk and bang! Suddenly to the back of a horrendous looking queue (EU Nationals) the Non-EU Nationals happily breezed passed us on the Left at speed only to find that further down the line (30 minutes later) both queues merged together! I then notice a printed sign that warned of a '30 minutes delay from this point' and I hear a pre- recorded announcement advising of delays. I pointed to the sign and asked a nearby police officer which part of the joke I missed he advised that 30 minutes is an underestimate he noticed that I had an ePassport and suggested a duck/dive/shove/push/jump/limbo route that halved the time. Maybe an earlier sign that reads 'ePassport holders this way' would have been nice. Eventually I am through ready to sprint to the shuttle bus because I know that if I don't get the 9.50pm train to Wellingborough from Parkway I will miss the last bus home. Wait I haven't re-claimed by bag yet the motionless conveyor belt was full with the previous flights luggage stacked on the floor. I boarded my train and collapsed with relief as the whistle was blown and the doors started to close.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Davis
content: Very surprised at the negative reviews about London Luton. I have a choice between Birmingham and Luton to fly to Dublin and have chosen Luton most of the time because it's that bit closer. It's not a pretty airport but it's easy to use and I totally disagree regarding the staff they have been some of the nicest (and consistently so!) of any airport I've used especially going through security without exception they have all been beyond friendly and helpful. Food choices are not bad and the facilities are generally clean. On the down side the gate I've mostly used Gate 15 is not great with only a few seats for a full plane load of passengers. In the general concourse too there are not enough seats unless you decide to use one of the restaurants or cafes. And you need a bus to get to the train station long term car parks and the car hire centre. But that can be expected at a lot of airports. Luton doesn't have the big airlines or traffic of the other London airports so I guess it hasn't had the same ability to develop top class facilities but it has always been a pleasant experience arriving or departing every time I've used it. I think some people leaving reviews should bear in mind that at Luton they're boarding airlines like Easyjet Ryanair and Wizzair. It's not the golden age of flying and we're not boarding Constellations to cross the Atlantic. This is Luton Airport with low cost airlines and they've done a great job each and every time I've gone through.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Lyndon
content: I viewed this site after travelling through Luton Airport and am somewhat relieved to see that I am not the only person who thinks that it's a dump ! I've been using the airport for many years but after what seems to be a steady decline in appearance service and actually getting to the airport I now only use it when all other options are limited. I find the parking facilities amongst the worse of probably any airport I've ever used. Why I have to navigate through traffic in the drizzle (no covered walkways in this climate?) in a sort of zig zag towards the terminal. I now use Stanstead (though that's got its own issues) instead but prefer Heathrow for its ease of access and easy parking.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: B Stevens
content: Luton to Reykjavik and return. The parking area is poor but the transfer bus was good the only saving grace about this place. The check-in was fine but the departure lounge was overcrowded. Security was a joke queues everywhere. On exiting the departure lounge for our flight we discovered there are no toilets before getting on the plane. The one we found back in the departure area was disgusting. On our return we had to wait on the tarmac to get to customs / immigration. The room itself as with departure facilities are totally inadequate. If you are flying from Luton and can find a better option take it. This place fails on all manner of things. Parking security toilets space and above all cleanliness.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: I Sderiz
content: I agree with other reviewers that there is a bit of grubbiness about the place. Staff were nice though. My advice is don't give yourself any extra time if using this airport - straight in and out.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: G Brown
content: Chaotic drab disinterested staff dirty facilities. Long walks to gates up and down stairs only to walk across the tarmac to climb stairs into a plane. Other small airports have far better facilities than Luton.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: L Sharp
content: Used Luton airport on the 25th October 2014 flying back from Lisbon due to staff cutbacks/shortages with the ground staff I was delayed leaving the plane by 30 minutes and another 30 minutes to clear boarder control. I would not recommend using Luton unless you have no other option.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Peter Mair
content: What a dump Luton Airport is! To get from aircraft to arrivals hall you are required to ascend and descent various sets of stairs and walk along corridors all in very poor state of decoration. Utterly unwelcoming. Less than half of immigration desks staffed though that is probably down to the Border Agency not the airport authorities.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: R De Ieso
content: Dirty and inefficient with rude staff. We queued for one hour to get through security and passport control. Aspire lounge is horrible. Limited food and with a very downmarket feel about the place. Dirty worn out chairs with stains on them. Luton Airport is a crowded grubby and unpleasant place to start any trip.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: L Jack
content: Luton Airport is a truly awful destination. There is no sense of it being designed for its existing number of passengers. Passport queues are long and sprawling escalators are sometimes shut leaving staircases more fitting to a small terraced house to service 1000s of arrivals. Surely fundamental changes need to take place in advance of the proposed developments.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Carole Stevens
content: I had the unfortunate misfortune to use Luton airport in September 2014. The arrivals heading to passport control was little more than a scrum. Being elderly and short I was pushed and knocked about by people who thought that queuing was optional! There were too many people trying to pass through to passport control in an area not designed for this number of people. We were herded along a tunnel which took over 1 hour just to reach passport control - there were not enough staff to deal with the volume of people and after another 30 minutes wait I was able to use my new style passport to get out! I dread to think what travelers from abroad think of their first taste of England.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Fortes
content: Firstly there is the awful journey to and from the airport (there's no dedicated train to/from London so you have to pile into whichever packed express train to/from Leicester or Nottingham is passing through and you then have to schlep onto a packed bus to get to/from the railway station). Once inside you enter an overcrowded area of queues that lasts all the way to the aircraft door. The main departure area inside the airport is about three times too small for the number of people passing through and you end up with vast crowds lurking near the corridor to the gates watching the departure boards. There are tiny areas by the gates themselves with no seating and which (for any pair of gates) is reached down a narrow staircase. Extraordinarily the airport seems to board two aircraft's from adjacent gates at the same time which results in two plane-loads of people queuing up the staircase and back down the corridor which means lots of confused people in the wrong queue pushing in and just lots of general unpleasantness. Getting onto the plane is just a nasty sweaty aggressive experience that I would never want to book-end an otherwise beautiful holiday.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Steven Varley
content: This airport is staggeringly poor and seems to be getting worse with time. Finding something positive to say about it is a struggle. There's little point in me listing the vast array of problems with Luton just read some of the review below. Suffice to say I am as experienced a traveller as some of the pilots that use it passing through it a minimum of twice per week and I loathe it increasingly with each visit. The route I fly is not well served therefore I have little choice but to fly from Luton although I choose Heathrow whenever possible and I'm willing to pay a premium to fly from there. It has descended into a national disgrace and an award winning representative for the problems incurred when money-grabbing private enterprise is given the concession to run a public service. The government needs to step in and take action I feel embarrassed to be British whenever I use this airport and witness the bewildered array of overseas visitors wondering what has happened.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Mitch Anderson
content: Parking especially is a big problem at Luton. Drop off / pick up car park had a 15 minutes limit for £2 but if you leave the car unattended within the 15 mins they will quickly tow it away and you have to pay a £80 fine. The truck drivers are actually watching for who's leaving the car. I've personally seen someone who had to help his old father with the luggage to the terminal and within 10 minutes his car was towed away to the mid term car park what a disgrace! As a kind of relief there's a 30 minutes free parking at mid term car park but the drivers must be very careful as it recently happened to me that I drove to the exit barriers after 28 minutes and somehow I've lost my ticket in the car I desperately looked for it another 2 minutes then finally found it. Well it was exactly 30 mins 25 seconds when I inserted it in the machine but I was asked to pay a full hours fee. When I called the car park office a grumpy guy simply said "you must pay I cannot let you out as you overstayed the free 30 minutes" and wouldn't listen that it's only been 25 seconds he was just repeating the above like a robot. And yes I had to pay £6.90 + £1.95 credit card fee - all this for a mere 25 seconds. My honest opinion as a traveller is that Luton is one of the worst airports in Europe even the eastern European airports are treating the customers with respect compared to Luton's staff treating us as cattle when coming into UK holding us in massive queues and seeing any airport user as a cash cow. All in all Luton is a really unwelcoming airport staff are often unhelpful to say at least there's even £2 charge for luggage trolley! Avoid this horrible airport if you can.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Miles
content: Airports come in all shapes and sizes and you kind of take them for what they are a temporary waiting room. Some are better then others and the really nice ones like Paris-Orly bring a certain romanticism back to flying. Unfortunately Luton is about as romantic as flying bricks to the head. It's as if someone turned a functioning airport and flipped it upside down then turned it in side out. Terminal concourses that are 4 stories high with no sky bridges for planes like the 737 and A-319. This means walking down 4 flights of stairs to get to the tarmac then climb back up stairs to get onto the airplane. I wasn't even mad I was dumbfounded. I really couldn't believe what I was seeing which made me chuckle a bit. Just to hammer the point home said concourses were extremely narrow and lacked any visible seating so it was standing room only until the plane was ready to board. I've only flown out the once so I don't know if this is just one terminal and concourse leg or an example of the entire airport. Judging by the spartan check in hall and uninterested security screeners talking about their weekend across two lanes I'm going to guess it's par for the course.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: P Oldacre
content: The passport control section needs help and quickly. We arrived at midnight along with we think 3 other planes and there were only two operatives at passport control. Surely there could have been more something needs to be done as this happened last year. Yes we have to check back into the UK but no we don't need to be treated like cattle.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: G Holmes
content: I have been using Luton for over 20 years for both business and pleasure and it just keeps getting progressively worse. I have had the privilege of travelling all over the world and even so called 3rd world countries do a better job than Luton. They seem obsessed with trying to extract the most amount of cash from every customer. There are queues for everything and unless you are lucky enough to be at a gate near the terminal you end up walking miles. I only live 20 minutes from the airport but would rather drive 50 minutes to Stansted than use Luton.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: R Hober
content: I'm normally not one to complain easily but Luton today was a very unpleasant experience. The wait at security was almost half an hour and yet 6 out of 12 positions were closed. And that's on a Friday afternoon/evening. On top some of the staff were really grumpy and unfriendly.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Stewart
content: Avoid if travelling to London. The airport bus is a misery and adds an hour to your transfer time by the time you've waited not been able to get on the first bus bought a ticket fought through traffic and then left at the station with 150 other passengers and 1 ticket desk. Gatwick and even Stansted much easier airport/rail interchange.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: C Marr
content: Why is Luton Airport charging for trolleys? I just had to witness a foreign visitor struggling in tears with her luggage and children as she didn't have any pounds or euros. I gave her the money she needed. I felt ashamed to be English!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: T Plummer
content: Sadly not a good experience. Landed at 11.35 massive passport queue not organised very well then onto baggage collect our flight came in before others and we were last out I couldn't believe it took an hour and a half. The airport needs more staff!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Turner
content: The worst UK airport in my experience. Most other airports supply free plastic bags at security for toothpaste etc Luton charge for this. Luton charges £2 for trolleys the last thing a passenger arriving from overseas needs if they have no change. We waited over an hour for our baggage on our return. Large queues at security it appears that they open and close x-ray stations to ensure long queues so people have to pay for priority security nowhere to put your shoes back on. Insufficient seating in the departure lounge almost no seating by the gates. Will only use this airport as a last report.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Boban Zarkovski
content: Very hostile place especially if you approach with a car would rather avoid it altogether if possible.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Lambert
content: Had early Tuesday morning flight with easyJet to Mykonos. Taxi set-down was ok if a bit of a chilly walk into terminal which is not easy with young children. After reading reports of delays and queues booked priority lane which worked well. Staff were friendly. Only downside charging non-refundable £2 for a trolley.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Hook
content: We flew in and out of Luton airport recently and found the whole experience very good the staff were always pleasant and helpful a real pleasure to pass through. My wife and I both commented on the good experience quite a refreshing change from many airports we have experienced.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Porter
content: Flew into London Luton last night - what a nightmare - worst airport experience by far. Airport staff were just plain incompetent runway wasn't ready gate wasn't ready had to be bussed in to terminal but buses weren't ready etc. But the worst was dealing with their sadistic border control agents who deliberately dragged on what should have been a straightforward process even though I was with my exhausted 5 year old and it was way past midnight. Will avoid this airport at all costs in the future.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Nagy
content: Luton airport just not able to handling the numbers of flights at all. When 3 flights arrive nearly same time the passport checking ruin your scheduled connection because they not able to handling such number of passengers. I'm a little Why? It looks so simple more passengers need more service! Any other airport management able to handling this only Luton airport management not care about this! My suggestion is avoid this airport or watch out when they are busy with flights - more than three flights arrival within 30 mins are too much for them!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Alastair Reid
content: I flew out of Luton last Thursday 17th July mid-morning. From my experience I entirely fail to see why so many people slate this airport. The only negative was the queuing to get off the M1 due to the roadworks and that is not the fault of the airport! I used an off airport car park called Central Car Storage it cost £30 for 6 days and is only 4 min from the terminal. Very easy quick and no hassle. Security was a breeze maybe 5 mins waiting and friendly and efficient staff. One of our bags was picked out for extra screening and this was handled in a professional manner. I would recommend Pret a Manger as the best place airside to kill time. They do a nice coffee for 99p (definitely the cheapest I have found in any airport or railway station recently) have quite comfortable chairs and a nice view of the runway. None of the departure facilities were overcrowded and the toilets were clean. It was a bit of a hike to gate 4 where our flight went from but nothing like the miles you can go at Gatwick sometimes. The flight (Ryanair) left on time. As we had hand baggage only I can't comment on bag check-in. All-in-all it was a perfectly acceptable experience and certainly comparable to many airports I have flown from in Europe. I would be happy to fly from there again any time. So don't believe all the reviews!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Federico Muscogiuri
content: The problems with this so called "airport" are very simple: a big increase in passenger traffic and a useless and inept management. Back in 2004 Luton was ok nothing special but perfectly acceptable as a low-cost airport nowhere near the hellhole that has become now. Nothing wrong with profit but that should not come at the expense of providing passengers with an acceptable travel experience. So here is my personal plea: passengers have a choice. Instead of complaining lets stop using this airport altogether and send a clear message to the people running this place. When they're hit in the wallet maybe then things will improve. They certainly cannot get any worse.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Harper
content: Truly a dreadful experience. One wonders why the Government allows the charlatans running this squalid gateway to and from the UK to get away with the miserable service that they provide. Flying to and returning from Hamburg emphasises the sense of German efficiency and British incompetence.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Angela Taylor
content: Absolutely appalling. We had to wait for over an hour for our luggage to arrive on the carrousel after arriving back from Faro last Saturday afternoon. No explanation and no one around to ask. How can it possibly take so long to get from the plane when it is such a short distance to the terminal. This is not the longest wait we have had for luggage at Luton we waited 2 hours the last time we used the airport. I felt sorry for the young families returning with very young children and babies their buggies were the last things to arrive from the plane! I certainly wouldn't recommend this airport to anyone.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: K Glasby
content: Travelled to Faro on 15th June with Easyjet. Was quick through check in the security people efficient no problems there. There were enough facilities for what we required. We were kept waiting on the stairs for nearly 30 minutes because our aircraft was awaiting an incoming flight which had passengers on for our flight. On our return on the 28th had a long wait for our suitcases but were quick through passport control. The driver of the bus to the mid term car park could have been more pleasant just sat in his seat no smile nothing looked as if he was doing his job under duress. Because our original flight on the 25th had been cancelled we over stayed our welcome by three days. So before we could get out of the car park and were charged an extra £60 a case of being taken advantage of compared to the original fee.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Vickers
content: Queues so long for EasyJet baggage drop and Luton security that you may miss your flight if you allow only 2 hours. Ridiculous.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Peter Dyer
content: Arrived at Luton two hour before flight departure and due to lack of staff had to wait three hours to check luggage in. Flight was delayed due to this. Arrived in Zakynthos and bag was lost. Waited four days for it to arrive. On return to Luton waited in aircraft for ten minutes because no one available to escort us from plane to arrival hall. Waited forty minutes for luggage to arrive at carousel. Appalling airport. So many staffing problems and luggage delay ruined our holiday. Though this is our local airport we are travelling three times as far for our next flight to east mids.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Martin
content: Arguably one of the most dysfunctional airports I have ever been to. Just getting there is a nightmare with constant road works right from the M1. Plus unlike every other London airport the train station is a 10 minutes bus journey away so you have to hang around waiting and trudge on and off busses and trains which are unreliable to say the least and not ideal with 20kg of luggage. The Terminal itself is a dark gloomy and dirty congested dump. Queues to Security are a joke with some passengers even backing onto the stairs and staff didn't make the process any better. Departures is fractionally better in terms of light but was cramped nowhere to sit shops and restaurants packed out lack of shops and restaurants toilets in bad condition and generally too hot and stuffy. When it came to boarding we were held in a narrow stairwell for 20 minutes which is unacceptable. Arrival was slightly better but still not good enough taking well over an hour from disembarking to walking outside the Terminal. The airport is just too small for how many passengers it handles and they want to expand from 10 to 18 million passengers a year with just a few extra Security lanes shops seating areas and a new car park? A place to always steer clear of I think.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Rhys Crompton
content: Luton Airport is not fit for how many passengers pass through the airport everyday. When I travelled to Spain last month passport control was heaving as 10+ flight had arrived at the airport in the space of an hour. Then you have to wait another half hour to collect your luggage. Absolutely ridiculous. Also the terminal is quite dirty and is looking very old and tired. Luton Airport needs a huge revamp if they are to compete with other airports in the London Area. But Luton is a local airport and easy to access. This is the only reason I fly from/to Luton.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: D James
content: Security staff at Luton are incredibly rude and grumpy. The queues are incredibly long and the airport is understaffed. By far the worst airport security team in the UK.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Peter Woolsey
content: Luton airport in my personal experience is not fit for purpose. Luton is very poorly sign-posted. It is extremely difficult to approach from the M1 and the Management of the airport appear to have made no attempt to recognise and deal with the difficulties. Equally there are competing parking firms one of which appears to be the official on-line firm for the main car park it is not. It appears that many people pay this other firm online arrive at the airport and then have to pay the top rate at the official car park. My flight cost about Â£ £100 the combined parking cost nearly £150. So do not use Luton airport until the management fix their amateur sign posting and prevent 'scam' parking schemes.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: K Kelliher
content: Airport is difficult to get to. Airport parking and airport shops are incredibly expensive in comparison to equivalent BAA facilities i.e. Stansted and other UK airports. Biggest problem at Luton airport is the constant bombardment of people conducting surveys. These individuals often pretend to be airport officials and give the impression that you do not have any option but to respond to their questions. I try to avoid this airport now. Heathrow and Stansted is much more user friendly.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: E Evans
content: The airport that loves queues! I travel a lot for work and Luton is by far the worst airport In the UK everywhere you go there are more queues to join whether you want a coffee or the toilet join the queue! A terrible airport experience.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Doran
content: Security staff needlessly ungracious and rude. I don't know why the security person decided that my transparent liquids bag wasn't suitable despite the fact that it has been half way around the world through numerous security checks. It's a beaten up clear plastic bag that is perhaps a centimetre too big however it only ever has two things in it and clearly unless you are out to sell a replacement plastic bag as a punishment should cause no one any grief at all. The jobsworth on security made me throw my plastic bag away. To the management at Luton try and remember your travelling public are your customers and we have a choice. I haven't flown out of Luton before and I won't again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Keith Warwick
content: Overall it is an ugly eyesore but perfectly functional and fairly easy to use. Could be a lot worse. Generally a good airport. Food not bad the breakfast baps are good but horrendously expensive food us a minus point here! We are not made of money.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: H Cooke
content: I travel a lot. I see many Airports. Luton is one of the worst. It is clear that the Owners and its Management know this. 'Which' rated it recently the worst airport in the UK and the reviews posted here are nearly all negative. Yet nothing changes. For those who want to see things improve I suggest that pressure should be put on the airlines that use Luton most like Easyjet. Were Easyjet to even threaten to withdraw from Luton Airport I suspect the Owners/Management might respond. They do not have to care about the likes of us passengers/customers. We are captive inconveniences. You fly from Luton because you have to you do not choose to do this. You wouldn't if you could choose but the airlines can and do. You choose the airlines you travel on so let them know that you would like to omit Luton airport from your travel plans till such time that it improves its facilities and the treatment of people who use it.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Russell Houchin
content: Oh deary me what a load of moaning minnies. The annual trip on holiday and they are up in arms about what they perceive as ghastly service standards from before they even step into the airport to when they have left. Oh and don't forget to grouse about coming back into Luton. Sadly despite all of that - yup - they will be back next year to have another crack at it and forget completely what they really should have learned and remembered the previous year. Hats off to Luton in 2014 - yes its a very fine airport operation these days - as good as most 10M passenger throughput airports - and far better than most. Secrets to make getting through faster and easier? Of course I have mine so let the moaners moan and just accept there all always people who create their own issues through not reading the paperwork or choosing to ignore it and then go looking for other 'problems'.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: P Skeet
content: We flew to Arrecife Lanzarote 3rd April via Ryanair. Despite the fact that we arrived at the 2 hr-before-flight- time recommended the queues at check-in desks were building fast. There were quite a few people who obviously had overweight bags and were being asked to adjust them. This seemed only to be happening at the Ryanair desks. Other adjacent C/I desks were moving at the normal rate. The flight was delayed by half an hour due to arguments and under-manning at the C/I stage. Although this is probably a regular feature when flying with Ryanair it should be discouraged by the airport authority as it leads to passenger stress potential rudeness to C/I staff and loss of revenue in the departure lounge and shops because passengers are denied any time to have a pre-flight break. Oh and the passenger drop-off fee of £2 whilst small is a cheek I think.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Eric Foxford
content: By far the worst airport I have experienced. Sadly it is often the most convenient for European visits. £2 for a Taxi drop off too far from the departures building. Then you have to pay for a trolley both going and upon your return. I dread what our overseas visitors think about that. Â£2 for the legally specified sized plastic bags to hold the regulation sized toothpastes / cosmetics face creams etc or else you will not be travelling. Then the chaos of the departure shopping mall. Minimum seating impossible departure signage almost invisible by neon screaming at you to come in and buy buy buy. Not a clock to be seen anywhere. Returning causes more anxiety it is not unusual for your baggage to take over an hour to appear on the carrousel shabby and miserable. To get a taxi for onward travel requires a pre arranged booking which is dodgy because you need to take into account the delayed baggage problem and heaven help you if it is raining and usually it does because you have the long trek to find the cab and again pay for a trolley and the £2 to release the cab from the car park.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: N Elb
content: Worst airport in Europe! I have been commuting around all big airports in Europe in the last few years. Flying 2-3 times a week. London Luton airport is by far the worst airport. Especially the people at the security checks are unbelievably rude and unprofessional. Shouting at passengers the entire time like they are inmates of a max security prison.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Kelly Cattigan Aine
content: Security staff at customs somewhat challenging. The plastic bag I was carrying my liquids in was too big! This bag was acceptable in 2 other airports. I had no change to purchase the bags that were the correct size and was told by the security man that I had better find the money from somewhere or I wouldn't be allowed to travel. At this point my 6 year old son who was travelling with me became very upset. A young man behind me in the queue gave me a pound to purchase the "correct" size plastic bags. Surly this rudeness by security staff was uncalled for.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Hughes
content: Apart from the fact that all the reviews describe Luton accurately. The depressing thing is that there is no acknowledgement from the Airport management that there is anything wrong. I can only conclude that it's ownership by Luton Borough Council puts it in the same category as most public services in Luton! The sooner they realise that everyone passing through the airport is a customer and not a cash cow to be exploited the better.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Andrew Harvey
content: By far the least pleasant airport I have used. The security staff (not all some) are like children in uniforms. No idea how to deal with people. The airport is unbelievably mercenary - £2 for dropping someone off money for plastic bags. The last time I traveled through Luton (January) - flying with Ryanair was the pleasant bit - nice staff efficient system. Never thought I would say that. If I had the equal choice - I would not choose Luton Airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Worpole
content: I can fully understand some of the bad reviews regarding Luton. I have been travelling through Luton every week for the past 18 months. For the first few weeks I experienced a lot of the issues especially with the Security Staff. They are not all bad but some of them are out and out "jobsworths" especially the resealable plastic bag merchants. I was told my bag was too big when all that was in it was a small tube of travel toothpaste and a 100ml Deodorant Spray. Needless to say I objected as I travel internationally all the time and had never had objections to my "oversize bag) at Heathrow Schipol Rome Sofia etc etc. Fortunately the guy before me had also been stitched up so he gave me one of his. Finally I wised up and now I always buy a Priority Pass through Security and I joined Priority Pass giving me Lounge access. Luton is what it is a budget airline airport. For me as a business traveller Luton is very convenient and as a lone traveller I just put up with all the pitfalls but I would hate to travel through there with a young family especially during the summer holidays - it just isn't geared up for it.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Blyth
content: Travelled through Luton on Friday at 0700. Whilst very busy no real delays through security and everything seemed to be running smoothly. Flight departed on time. Returning on Sunday at 1900 again no problems other than having to wait about 10/12 mins for our luggage. Overall quite satisfactory.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Fiona Fu
content: The rudest security check staff I have seen. Inverness is not far behind Luton sadly for the beautiful country where my husband was born and it's the reason we come back again and again anyhow we will not fly but take trains or drive.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Witkowska
content: Travelling with children (5 year old and 6 month old baby) through Luton was a challenge. Queued on the stairs when boarding (Gate 17) for at least 20 minutes. Many families carrying babies in prams some got stuck in the corridor on the stairs where lack of air transfer makes the situation even worse. Ridiculous!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Ana Oliveira
content: Very disappointed that the security services are so slow it took over half an hour to get true and due to this I missed the flight and had to buy another ticket and having to wait over 4 hours to the next flight.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J House
content: Another horrendous visit to Luton Airport. Despite vowing I would never go there again I did. Having arrived 1 hr and 15 mins prior to my flight (and at 0600hrs) the queue through security was evidently going to take too long forcing me to pay for a priority pass. Whilst going through I was then told the plastic bag which my liquids were in was too big. When I asked why every other airport I have travelled through (10-15) accepts them I was given no explanation. It was re stated that I need to spend money buying their bags. When through in departures it is even more evident that the capacity is simply not enough the number of passengers. Despite being very early every shop cafe and seating area was overwhelmed. More queues for any of the places to eat and numerous people sitting in corridors due to the lack of seating. Luton Airport management need to look at other small airports Southampton Edinburgh etc who can get the service right. I will not use this airport again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Bithell
content: Visited twice and a terrible experience both times. Wanted to collect a friend and tried to book mid term car parking for an hour website wouldn't let me. Left car there on understanding you get 30 min free spent 10 min waiting for bus to terminal and 15 min waiting for the bus back ended up paying almost £20 for an hours parking or £20 for 30 min if you take away the 30 min free. Second time I used the drop off that costs £2. It feels terrible having to just dump friends at the roadside pay £2 for the privilege of doing so and then panic about getting out. 15 min from driving in and out is not enough to get people out of a car coats on luggage out and then say goodbye few days later I get a bill in the post saying I had overstayed my 15 min and a fine of £80. Currently arguing the point as my clock & watch say I was out of there before 15 min. Feels like they are desperate to rip off all people passing through the airport maybe from trolley hire VIP security express boarding etc. I'm surprised they haven't starting charging for using toilets yes. I've spent 13 years travelling and working all over the world I've never had the same terrible feeling of being conned as I did after going into Luton. I'll be trying hard to avoid ever returning and will be telling all my friends to avoid it.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Simon Castleman
content: Queuing taken to an art form. Queued to check in - 40 minutes (its much worse early morning as many flights go before 09.00) queued for security 30 minutes. Queued on the stairs near the airbridge 20 minutes when boarding. On the way back queued for 20 minutes at passport control. On the basis you spend all your time queuing there is not time to visit the shops they will try and rob you at every opportunity (£2 for a plastic bag etc). There were two you ladies travelling on my inbound flight with young children one of whom was heavily pregnant. Were the buggies delivered to the aircraft steps? - no they were delivered the baggage belt a good way away and on the other side of the ridiculous passport queue. I've been though a lot of airports in my time and this has got to be the worst I've ever had the misfortune to use. Its 30+ years since I travelled from this joke of an airport and I will not use again unless there is no other option.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Lynch
content: We will never fly from Luton airport again. Security is simply a money making scam at this airport. The only liquid I had was an anti-bacterial gel less than 100ml which I took out of my carry on bag and placed in the tray for x-ray. The security person said it needs to be in a re-sealable clear plastic bag. I asked for one he said they were £1 each. I said the anti-bacterial cost less than that and he could keep it. I then noticed the person in front of me had several loose liquid bottles in their tray (not in a bag) and pointed it out to him. He said "I didn't check that tray my colleague did". However this wasn't the only issue my wife never takes liquids out of her handbag when going through security and she's been pulled up on it every time at Gatwick Stansted and Heathrow. My wife was behind me this time at Luton airport security and again left her liquids in her bag. They went through the x-ray machine and no one pulled her up on having liquids in her handbag and it wasn't one little mascara but several liquids in small bottles such as cosmetics nose drops and an anti-bacterial. Therefore my conclusion is that the security is a joke and they don't care if you have liquids in your handbag but if you put them loose in the tray on show then prepare to be charged a £1 for bag.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Saunders
content: I work as a driver for a major travel company taking and collecting clients from mainly Heathrow and Gatwick Airports. I had the misfortune to collect clients for the first time from Luton on Monday. What an absolute disgrace of an airport waiting to rip you off at every turn. They had the audacity to charge £7.90 for an hours parking on what looks like a bomb site then wanted another £1.75 to pay by credit card and all with a very long walk and no shelter from bad weather from terminal to car. (Heathrow T5 is £6.00 per hour undercover two minutes from the Terminal and no credit card fees. I will be speaking to the Tour Organiser and asking them not to use this airport again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: L Watt
content: Staff either utterly disinterested or extremely rude. Total rip off with paying for plastic bags at security. I was forced to buy despite having provided my own as apparently it was the wrong size and prevented from progressing through security until I had done so. Biggest problem is rudeness of staff and their attitude to customers in general have never felt this way in an airport before. Will not fly from here again!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: B Jones
content: I have the dubious 'pleasure' of having to fly from this airport twice a week just getting dropped off is an issue! The airport appear to have fences along the roadsides on a two mile radius around the airport forcing you into a minimum Â£2 drop off area. If you want to park longer take out a mortgage and don't expect a car park - imagine pouring tarmac onto a ploughed field and you get a feel for where you will leave your car. The staff in security are unbelievably rude which is a shame as you will spend so long in there by the time you get out they will feel like family to you the queues are huge and generally only two lanes are open of which one I believe is mainly for gruff and grumpy staff to use. OK arriving if you are lucky enough to be at the gate near arrivals I envy you the rest of us have to wait 10 minutes for a bus as our arrival always appears to take the ground crew by surprise I mean its a big orange aircraft what's not to miss? On departures this week we sat onboard for an hour as we waiting for the fuel truck to arrive If I could fly from a different airport I would my suggestions on improving the airport? Knock it down and try again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Yugin
content: How can they charge £2 for a drop-off which took all of 30 seconds and charge £2 for a trolley? The drop-off is not even adjacent to the terminal! Even the staff agreed with me it was a rip-off.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: T Hodge
content: What a joke of an airport. Trying to get every extra pound out of you. £2 to drop someone off £5 for one hour of wifi for starters. Just things you would expect 'international airports' to provide free of charge. Security were on the grumpy side but on par with other airports. Got through reasonably quickly as we flew at a quiet time of day. Only about 5 seats at every boarding gate so when flying with an airline with no seat allocation you're sitting on the floor for at least 30 minutes waiting to board to get a choice of seat. Coming back into the UK the EU passport line was very long and the non-EU very short. We were held up a bit longer as non-EU passport holders due to others ahead of us having visa problems but staff worked as efficiently as possible to get through the backlog. In terms of facilities and charges it's not what I expect of an international airport. Bus terminals have more class than this airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Ciubuc
content: This is the most horrible airport I have travelled from more than once. My experience include: At least 3 hour delay on the flights especially the Wizz Air flight to Romania on Friday night. I understand that sometimes the flight comes with a delay from Romania but this does not excuse the following: 1) Flight arrives and employees forget to take the stairs so that passengers can come out of the plane. This happens while outbound passengers are waiting in the tightest space some on the stairs down waiting for the staff to open the doors. 2) No matter the low cost airlines there is no line for priority and normal priority passengers have to push their way through. 3) Sending passengers to the wrong gates I once walked for 15 minutes with all my luggage from one side to the other after I had sat in the wrong line for 5 minutes. 4) Staff were extremely rude. 5) Flights are listed on the internet far later than they should so I don't even know I have a four hour delay until I get to Luton. 6) One time it took them 1 hour to take me out of the airport after I had passed through security and my flight was cancelled. The employee escorting me did not know how to take me out and the information desk was sending me to the wrong place to meet my escort. I fly very often so I understand that the probability of problems happening to me is higher than usual but with a bit of organisation on behalf of the airport most problems could be fixed.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S James
content: Although mid-term car park is advertised as free for the first 30 mins you will be very easily charged because it is almost impossible to return to your vehicle in less than 32-33mins. I have used multiple times the mid-term car park to leave my car whilst taking someone to the airport and only once I've managed to return in 28mins. They should make the first 60mins free and/or allow you to walk into the terminal. I guess it's just a way for them to make easy money with us. Most of the times I've used that car park I was charged because I have returned in 32 33 35 43 minutes. It is incredible. What they are thinking? I mean they don't even have asphalt. They charge you for leaving your car on a muddy field.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Earley
content: On traveling to Dublin this Sunday 27/10/13. I could not be less impressed with the security staff. My wife who has a prosthetic leg had to tell three separate people why the alarm was going off. The supervisor came over and asked again my wife quite rightly pointed out that this was the fourth time she had to explain what was wrong no apology was offered instead the supervisor said 'give her a full body search if you have to' they then asked my wife to expose the foam on her leg so they could take a swab. All of this was done in front of my four children who where waiting on their own at the end of security I to was searched the whole process in my opinion was a power trip for the badly mannered and ignorant supervisor. I fully understand security at airports but at no point should these people think they are not accountable the staff at Luton need to go to Dublin for some training they were so discreet and polite.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: R Carter
content: Friday evening 18th October 2013. A dismal experience. the staff at both the Fast track entrance and the desk just prior to entering the long winding queue were downright rude and officious. The entire procedure made us feel like a nuisance to the staff. The scanner operators were slightly cheerful but overall I would never willingly choose LTN as a departure point again - only as a last resort.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Davies
content: A drop off charge of £2 is outrageous £1 for a security plastic bag is equally outrageous. Arrivals is a labyrinth of corridors  queues and doors. Toilets in arrivals disgusting. Security unnecessarily officious unhelpful and slow. The worst airport security experience I have had.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Shepherd-Stubbs
content: Luton drop off zone where it can cost 9.21 pounds per minute. We use this airport for 10 return trips a year on average flying in and out of Spain if we had the opportunity to use a convenient alternative we would not hesitate. On 17th July we went to collect some Spanish friends their flight was delayed by 15 minutes and like a previous reviewer we didn't see the sign that said 15 minutes maximum wait. So we sat in our car for the extra 14 minutes not leaving it once. We then left and went on our way on the 18th July we flew back to Spain. When we returned in September there were two letters waiting one a fixed penalty notice for £80 sent 10 days after the collection and a second legal letter saying the case had been referred. We were not given the option to pay the reduced amount and to cut a very long story short this has now cost £131. Coupled with the rude service from security staff who insist that even with toiletries in a clear bag that their own need to be used this airport and it's staff are probably the worst in the UK and you have to take a deep breath to walk through smokers polluting the entrances and exits. Avoid if you can possibly fly from somewhere else. Alicante is head and shoulders above this airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: N Quilty
content: Luton airport must be UK's worst airport yesterday I travelled from Luton to Dublin airport we were called to board one hour before our flight was due to leave we ended up at gate 15 I was shocked to arrive and find that there was a very long queue down a corridor and then down a narrow flight of stairs where we were hoarded like cattle going to market we all ended up in a tiny room no more that the size of a small classroom at least 200 of us! We had to stand there for what seemed like hours and had to put up with babies crying buggies one man coughing like a horse and proceeding to spit into his hankie and no seating or toilets. This so called gate is not a gate it should be condemned not only for the over crowding but the danger it contains. Please can I request that this gate be closed down it's not safe and it's a disgrace to the Luton airport authority.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Trevor Yorke
content: Merely collecting anyone by car at Luton Airport is now a dreadful experience. The signage for example is appalling. Having to pay merely to pause to collect someone is a disgrace. Having not been there for a while I had to drive around the one way system three times before I understood what one is meant to do. Having I thought understood the procedure I put££2 into a machine I was immediately directed towards the exit so had to go through the whole process again leaving my son standing non-plussed on the kerbside. In it's relentless efforts to make as much profit as possible the airport authority sight has been lost of making a visit to Luton Airport a pleasant experience. Meeting our son after an 18th month period abroad was completely ruined and made unnecessarily stressful. Altogether appalling - but what do they care?

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: M Erlick
content: Arrived back from Antalya on October 12 at just past midnight flight was early. It should have arrived at 00.30. Waited over an hour 30 minutes for our luggage with absolutely no explanation of the delay other than two pre- recorded statements asking for our patience. When Servisair were asked for a comment their representative stated that the flight prior to ours was late and that ours was early. Do they actually have more than one crew working on baggage handling at this time of the morning? This state of affairs is unacceptable and perhaps Thomson Airways should consider taking complaints of this type to the Airport Management direct. Servisair are obviously not doing their job properly. Also security staff are rude and why is it that at other airports there is hardly any queuing at security or check in?

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Groyer
content: My experience is consistent with many of the reviews posted on this website. Rude security staff. Overly invasive security checks with no regard for the actual threat posed. No seating facilities at the gates so you stand for ages. On a previous visit I stood in a passage for an hour because they called the flight even though it wasn't ready. No information is provided while standing around. Here I believe the airport and airline in this case Easyjet are jointly responsible. I have no intention of subjecting myself to these degrading experiences in future so will stay away from Luton Airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S O'Dwyer
content: Luton Airport and facilities. Very very sad to see one of our UK airports like this. The parking costs are very expensive the attitude of the people running the place is awful. From the minute you turn into the airport complex checking in security. We all know we need security but where did these security people get their training and attitude? This airport used to be ideal to get in and out of Europe. I will never use it again or recommend our customers to use it. To understand what I mean about Luton Airport look back ten and twenty years ago.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: G Morgan
content: We travelled from Luton airport on 19th September 2013 and the experience was appalling. We are in our 60s and were carrying a bag each of around 9kgs. We thought we would take a trolley but to our amazement unlike anywhere else in Europe we were expected to pay £2 to do so. We just carried the bags the long uncovered distance from the car-park to the departures terminal. Once there we joined a long and what seemed interminable queue. Once through security we rejoined the queue for our plane and had to queue again on a dark staircase for at least 15 minutes. The arrangements at Girona both arriving and leaving were a totally different story with free trolleys and smiling helpful staff everywhere. On arriving back at Luton today we were all including a fairly disabled elderly man forced to walk for what seemed like miles up and down stairs from the plane to the arrivals hall this followed by a further trolley-less walk across to the car had it been raining we would have been soaked. What a pity! Luton used to be a convenient and friendly airport enabling passengers to travel in comfort. Nowadays the only resulting feelings after travelling from there are anger and stress. With a choice of both East Midlands and Birmingham as well as Stansted available to travellers from the south-east/midlands Luton should acknowledge that it is not performing as it should and will end up losing customers.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Allsopp
content: My son and 3 friends were booked to fly to Berlin. Having only hand luggage they thought they would not have a problem with security queues. There was. A massive queue and they missed their flight by 15 minutes! When they tried to get help they found staff very unhelpful and most of them unable to understand what they were saying as they didn't speak much English! They had to pay £60 each for another ticket and £43 each for a night in a grubby Ibis hotel! Luton airport is chaotic and I am surprised anyone bothers to fly from it! Coming back from Berlin they had no trouble - through security in 10 minutes and staff speaking English and very helpful!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: S Tracey
content: I had to collect an elderly relative and decided to park in the Short Stay Car Park. The surface is very uneven and very poor quality. It was raining and as the whole car park is on one level and outside we got soaked! The spaces are so close together. The route around the car park doesn't flow there are dead ends that if you aren't that great at reversing you would have a terrible time as there is no room to turn around. It took me 15 minutes to find a space and I was charged Â£11 for 1hr 40 mins which I think is a disgrace. What sort of impression does this leave people travelling into the UK via this airport.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Nancy Morgan
content: Luton Airport is not up to standard staff are rude and lazy. Please do something about this as people will not keep using this airport and Wizz Air are so good. I used Luton on Wednesday 11th September and feel sad that I have to write such a bad report. The man who took us from assisted passage was so rude along with other staff.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Jon Quick
content: I live locally and am so disappointed with so many aspects of the way customers are treated from drop off prices attitude at customs check points demanding only 1 plastic bags purchased unnecessarily and forced to back of huge queue to very long waits at passport control. So even though it is local I am now using Stansted or Gatwick.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Federico Muscogiuri
content: The previous reviews sum up the Luton experience and there is little I can add that has not already been said. However what worries me is that this situation has been going on for at least 5 years without any signs of improvement. Passengers should simply vote with their feet as in my opinion this is the only way the management in this so-called airport will do something about it. All London airports have their limitations but Luton takes the biscuit. I am now carefully avoiding this airport even if it means paying more for my flight.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Don Bartlett
content: I had to pick up my daughter from Luton Airport. When you arrive at the roundabout outside the terminal there is a mass of signs and no time to decide. I saw the large sign for the drop-off and pick-up point and headed for that. £2 for 15 mins. I didn't see the smaller signs saying "unattended cars will be removed" but on returning after a few minutes I saw my car being towed away. The parking area was deserted so I suppose the tow-vehicle must have been standing around waiting for a fresh victim. It cost £180 to have it released. Apparently this happens about 20 times a day more at the weekend. I will never have anything to do with Luton Airport again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: D Carter
content: Appalled with this airport. £2 charge for drop off is unquestionably exorbitant security staff are rude and answer back to customers check in is managed by incompetents with queues out the door and I had the novel experience of queuing at gate 18 which shares the same space as that for gate 17 on a flight of stairs. Mothers with children and prams were queuing on a flight of stairs. Luton is undoubtedly one of the worst airports I have experienced and it cannot fail to put me in a bad mood at the beginning of my holiday. I am ashamed that Luton is a British airport. Avoid it.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: E Sutton
content: So Luton have come bottom in the UK airports customer survey! I am not surprised at all. Having to pay £2 to drop someone off pay for a trolley and then the total insult - having to pay £1 for 2 plastic bags for medicines and liquids! Total joke. I also use Edinburgh frequently and the 2 airports are poles apart! Luton seriously needs to wake up and smell the roses otherwise it will come bottom all the time.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Quarles
content: Last month I went on a family trip with 2 adolescents and 2 parents to London. Since we were traveling with hand luggage only the departure hall seemed an easy hurdle for our return trip. After a pleasant stay in London we arrived in Luton departure hall an hour and a half before take off. There were long queues at the luggage counters especially the Easyjet counters. Confident because we could bypass this queue we took a short break before we went to passport control and security check. No written or verbal signs whatsoever about the massive queues that were ahead of us. Then after showing our passports and boarding cards we entered a huge space on this review site better described as an immigration hall fully packed with people duly following a labyrinth of ropes. The end of this story is also described by many visitors of this site. Queuing time for ordinary hand luggage turned out to take at least 1 hour. Customs officers working to rule having all passengers take of their shoes inspecting items while our gate was about to close. Running on our socks we reached on the off-chance the right place where 23 people were standing before an already closed gate. Going through the reviews more then 20 people missing a plane because of queuing times at Luton seems business as usual. I wish that I had read these reviews before! When you really take the chance of traveling via Luton airport be prepared to miss your flight. Easyjet will sell new tickets for 60 pounds each and in case it is late you can book a hotel for circa 45 pounds per room. We will at least think twice before making a new booking. The same counts for Easyjet who well aware of logistic problems at Luton doesn't take trouble in warning its clients in advance redirecting any complaint to Luton airport not in the least troubled by earning extra at the expense of its derogated clients.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Johnny Robinson
content: What a terrible time at Luton airport. The security staff were rude and could not care less about standards and the way they spoke to people. When entering passport control on my return the situation at the passport desk was shocking with about 500 people trying to clear immigration. The immigration staff when confronted with concerns just looked at you as if you were from another planet. I am not using Luton anymore it is awful.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Peter Edwards
content: I've been using Luton Airport for over 40 years and have experienced its general decline to what it is now in 2013 the worst airport in the whole of the UK. In the last 5 years I've been travelling in addition to other destinations to Majorca between 5 and 7 times a year and it's almost a relief during the winter months when Easyjet don't fly to Palma to have to make the trip from Stansted which is 3 times the time and distance. The complaints are endless surly unhelpful security staff who often talk joke and laugh with their fellow workers about what they did last night and what they are doing tonight. Untidy and overpriced eating facilities. The lack of telescopic walkways to the plane makes it look more third world. I find it particularly galling that on arrival you walk up one set of stairs along a corridor then down another set of stairs. No other airport I've visited in the last ten years makes you do this. I now make most of my trips with just hand luggage as the baggage handlers must be the slowest in the country for what must be the shortest distances. I picked my son up from Luton a few days ago who had flown in from Edinburgh a lovely clean efficient and helpful airport and was aghast that they had put up the pick up/ drop off charge to £2. This is typical of this money grabbing terribly organised airport. I don't know how the new owners are going to improve things but if I may offer just one recommendation it is that they should sack every employee and make them re apply for their jobs and use a top recruitment agency from London who would sort the wheat from the chaff. NB. I always leave Luton Airport with a bad taste in my mouth which is brought about by the clouds of cigarette smoke that you can't void as you make your exit. Disgusting!

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: D Allen
content: This is a dreadful airport and does not deserve to be called Luton London. The parking arrangements are a joke the range of pre-flight facilities and quality of catering is terrible. The toilet facilities seem to rarely see any cleaning staff and there is a need to pay £2 for a trolley. Given that Luton probably needs the economic development and jobs provided by the airport I suggest the local community makes the management more accountable for what they are doing. I will not be going back.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Ray Thompson
content: I have not used this airport for years and was dropping some people off on their honeymoon. I had £1 for drop off charge which I had been warned about. When I arrived it had risen to £2 which I did not have. I had driven down from Northampton in my old knock around clothes and would not be seen dead out and about trying to get some money. I have now found out you can go into the Mid-term car park for free. But if you are a stranger to the airport try and read all those signs as you negotiate all the various roundabout. I may now have a fine for dropping people off in a restricted area but what do you do when you are flapping. I was bringing customers to the airport and they charge me for that. It is a cheap money grabbing airport with airlines who cars as much about their customers as the airport. If a high street shop tried to charge me for bringing my custom to them as I walked through the door then I would vote with my feet as I will do with Luton. I have to pick my relations up upon their return and that will be the last Luton Airport will ever see of me again. Why do you all put up with the drop-off fees?

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Derek Green
content: Disgusted to have to pay 2 pounds to drop someone off it took a few moments. Very poor show. Will not fly from there again.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: C Munday
content: Only Luton has a consistently terrible attitude and service level. "Whatever" is the overall attitude. From paying for plastic bags to layout cleanliness slow buses cages security management. Staff don't care and neither does its management. Appalling for airlines brands influences heavily where and with whom I fly. Until it looses them money they will do nothing. Vote with your feet. Use your money cleverly.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: W Hartl
content: I remember Luton as a convenient airport for some budget flights years ago. This time we departed June 25 midday. The security queues were long and there appeared to be nervousness in the crowd and a lack of staff managing the queues. I noticed that Luton offers a paid "priority service" for getting better treatment at security. I find it unacceptable that the airport operator is trying to monetize the harassment they cause themselves by their poor performance and management of security queues! It seems to me like getting money out of passengers who need to get to their planes instead of running the airport efficiently and effectively. For clarification my view is not about saving a few pounds but about security being a public issue and not an extra revenue opportunity for an airport operator.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: J Warren
content: Having recently used this airport it is clearly evident that it is mainly geared towards low cost flights. The check in area is in desperate need of re-organisation (lots of confused passengers too few check in desks open and under staffed) results in huge crowds all confined in one small space with the other half of the check in hall being empty and unused. On a plus side going through security was quick and well organised. The departure lounge itself was alright with a good variety of (over priced) shops and restaurants. However the boarding system and gate area at Luton seriously needs to be improved; you are forced to shove for a place in the line and then be prepared to wait for a plane that hasn't even landed yet. Furthermore there is absolutely nowhere to sit down in the gate area which could be a problem for families with young children. Furthermore none of Luton's gates are fitted with jet bridges like Stansted so bring a coat with you in case it rains! On return we had to wait for over an hour for our suit case which is unacceptable. They kept stopping and restarting the conveyor (You'd think it would've just been easier to move the luggage onto a conveyor that actually worked properly!). All in all this pretty much sums up the experience you can expect if you travel through Luton airport and I would strongly advise that you stay well clear unless there is absolutely no other alternative.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: Howard Barker
content: The terminal has the appearance of a warehouse from the outside but for a Wednesday lunchtime flight it was all very painless. No queue to speak of for bag drop and security remarkably quick considering they have a paid-for fast track lane. Returning early evening passport control was much faster than Gatwick and bags waiting. Eating drinking and shopping facilities a bit limited. The wait for buses from the railway station adds to the time travelling to and from there as they only seem to leave when full. Might be a different story on a Saturday morning in August.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: N Montgomery
content: By far the worst airport I have ever been to in terms of the security staff. They are so rude unhelpful and clearly untrained when it comes to children and families. An absolute embarrassment to the UK.

title: Luton Airport customer review
author: A Martin
content: Luton is probably the worst of the London airports in my view yet it still has its good point and I have been to far worse airports before. The biggest problem is getting there. Whilst rail services to Luton Airport Parkway are very quick and regular Luton is the only London airport to have no on site railway station and therefore requites a shuttle bus ride to/from the terminal and that can really slow things down. The drive to the terminal from the M1 motorway J10 is atrocious and frequently congested. Speaking of congestion the airport terminal gets very busy in the morning and I believe nearly half the days departures leave before 9am. The relatively compact airport can get very busy in the morning period and queue times reflect this. We had to queue for a good 20 minutes to reach security which is significantly longer than at Stansted or even Heathrow T3. On the plus side the airport is very nice if flying after 9am where queues are shorter (but still could be better) and the departure lounge is bright and spacious. There's not as good a range of facilities like shops or restaurants as other London airports but it's still not bad considering the size of the airport and you do have everything you want or need before you fly. I have also never experienced poor service from staff although I have never had the misfortune to experience it really at any airport. One thing about Luton is that I can't really see it changing or improving much in the short to medium term as it's always very samey.
